#Build community 

```{r}
metadata     <- readRDS("data/processed/metadata.rds")
selected_vars <- readRDS("data/processed/selected_vars.rds")
env_rast      <- terra::rast("data/processed/env_rast_masked.tif")
ref <- env_rast[[1]]

# Assign each isolate to a pixel
metadata$cell <- terra::cellFromXY(ref, as.matrix(metadata[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]))
md <- dplyr::filter(metadata, !is.na(cell))

# Sites = occupied pixels
cells   <- sort(unique(md$cell))
site_xy <- terra::xyFromCell(ref, cells)
site_df <- data.frame(cell = cells, site_lon = site_xy[, 1], site_lat = site_xy[, 2],
                      site_id = paste0("S", seq_along(cells)))
md <- dplyr::left_join(md, site_df[, c("cell", "site_id")], by = "cell")

# Site x cluster matrix
comm_mat <- md |> dplyr::distinct(site_id, Groups) |> dplyr::mutate(present = 1) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Groups, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("site_id")
comm_mat <- comm_mat[site_df$site_id, ]

# The 12 SDM predictors at each site pixel
site_env <- terra::extract(env_rast, site_df$cell)[, selected_vars, drop = FALSE]
rownames(site_env) <- site_df$site_id

# Dominant host and country per site (ties: first in alphabetical order)
site_host <- md |> dplyr::group_by(site_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Plant_host = names(which.max(table(Plant_host))),
                   Country    = names(which.max(table(Country))), .groups = "drop")
site_host <- site_host[match(site_df$site_id, site_host$site_id), ]

# Drop sites with a missing predictor (pixel outside the predictor mask)
keep <- which(complete.cases(site_env))
n_iso_dropped <- sum(!(md$site_id %in% site_df$site_id[keep]))
community <- list(comm    = comm_mat[keep, ],
                  env     = site_env[keep, ],
                  coords  = site_df[keep, c("site_lon", "site_lat")],
                  host    = site_host$Plant_host[keep],
                  country = site_host$Country[keep],
                  site_id = site_df$site_id[keep])
stopifnot(length(community$host) == nrow(community$comm),
          length(community$country) == nrow(community$comm),
          nrow(community$env) == nrow(community$comm))
saveRDS(community,"data/processed/community.rds")
```

#PERMANOVA by Host, Country, HostxCountry, CountryxHost, betadisper

```{r}
comm <- comm_obj$comm
meta <- data.frame(Host = factor(comm_obj$host), Country = factor(comm_obj$country))
perm <- function(f, by = NULL) {
  set.seed(42)
  vegan::adonis2(f, data = meta, method = "jaccard", permutations = 999, by = by)
}
perm_host    <- perm(comm ~ Host)
perm_country <- perm(comm ~ Country)
perm_h_then_c <- perm(comm ~ Host + Country, by = "terms")
perm_c_then_h <- perm(comm ~ Country + Host, by = "terms")
print(perm_host); print(perm_country); print(perm_h_then_c); print(perm_c_then_h)

#betadisper (Dispersion)
d <- vegan::vegdist(comm, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
set.seed(42); bd_host <- vegan::betadisper(d, meta$Host)
set.seed(42); pt_host <- vegan::permutest(bd_host, permutations = 999)
set.seed(42); bd_ctry <- vegan::betadisper(d, meta$Country)
set.seed(42); pt_ctry <- vegan::permutest(bd_ctry, permutations = 999)
# countries with a single site (Ang, Esw) removed
big  <- names(which(table(meta$Country) > 1))
keep <- meta$Country %in% big
d2   <- vegan::vegdist(comm[keep, ], method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
bd2  <- vegan::betadisper(d2, droplevels(meta$Country[keep]))
set.seed(42); pt2 <- vegan::permutest(bd2, permutations = 999)
print(pt_host); print(pt_ctry); print(pt2)

tab <- function(a, label) data.frame(model = label, term = rownames(a), as.data.frame(a), row.names = NULL)
write.csv(rbind(tab(perm_host, "Host"), tab(perm_country, "Country"),
                tab(perm_h_then_c, "Host + Country"), tab(perm_c_then_h, "Country + Host")),
          ("outputs/permanova_jaccard.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(nmds = nmds_res, nmds_stress = nmds$stress_lab,
             perm_host = perm_host, perm_country = perm_country,
             perm_host_then_country = perm_h_then_c, perm_country_then_host = perm_c_then_h,
             betadisper_host = pt_host, betadisper_country = pt_ctry,
             betadisper_country_no_singletons = pt2),
        "data/processed/stats_nmds_perm.rds")

```

#MEMs, Variance partitioning

```{r}
st  <- readRDS("data/processed/stats_nmds_perm.rds")
comm_h <- vegan::decostand(comm, "hellinger")

#Predictors 
env_s   <- scale(cv$env)                                   
host_mm <- model.matrix(~ host, data.frame(host = factor(cv$host)))[, -1, drop = FALSE]

#dbMEM
mem    <- adespatial::dbmem(as.matrix(cv$coords), MEM.autocor = "positive", silent = TRUE)
mem_df <- as.data.frame(mem)
rownames(mem_df) <- rownames(comm)
cat("dbMEM vectors with positive autocorrelation:", ncol(mem_df), "\n")
SEED_COMM <- 42
rda_mem <- vegan::rda(comm_h ~ ., data = mem_df)
set.seed(SEED_COMM); gl <- anova(rda_mem, permutations = 999)
r2a <- vegan::RsquareAdj(rda_mem)$adj.r.squared
cat("Global MEM model: p =", gl$`Pr(>F)`[1], "| adj R2 =", round(r2a, 3), "\n")

mem_sel <- NULL; mem_names <- character(0)
if (gl$`Pr(>F)`[1] <= 0.05) {
  set.seed(SEED_COMM)
  fs <- adespatial::forward.sel(Y = comm_h, X = mem_df, adjR2thresh = r2a, nperm = 999)
  mem_names <- as.character(fs$variables)
  mem_names <- mem_names[order(as.integer(sub("\\D+", "", mem_names)))]
  mem_sel <- mem_df[, mem_names, drop = FALSE]
}
cat("Selected MEMs (", length(mem_names), "): ", paste(mem_names, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
stopifnot(!is.null(mem_sel))

#Variation partitioning: env | host | space
vp <- vegan::varpart(comm_h, env_s, host_mm, mem_sel)
print(vp)
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
t_env   <- anova(vegan::rda(comm_h, env_s,   cbind(host_mm, mem_sel)), permutations = 999)
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
t_host  <- anova(vegan::rda(comm_h, host_mm, cbind(env_s, mem_sel)),   permutations = 999)
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
t_space <- anova(vegan::rda(comm_h, mem_sel, cbind(env_s, host_mm)),   permutations = 999)
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
t_all   <- anova(vegan::rda(comm_h, cbind(env_s, host_mm, mem_sel)),   permutations = 999)

#IndVal by host
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
iv <- indicspecies::multipatt(comm, cv$host, func = "IndVal.g",
                              control = permute::how(nperm = 999))
summary(iv)

#Save
res <- c(st, list(varpart = vp, mem_selected = mem_names, mem_scores = mem_sel,
                  mem_global = gl, mem_global_adjR2 = r2a,
                  test_env = t_env, test_host = t_host, test_space = t_space, test_all = t_all,
                  indval = iv))
saveRDS(res, "data/processed/community_results.rds")

#--------------------------------------------------------Maps-----------------------------------------------------------------------
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
sel    <- res$mem_selected
scores <- res$mem_scores
sites  <- cbind(site_id = cv$site_id, cv$coords, scores)

#Scores for every site, one column per selected MEM (supplementary table)
write.csv(sites, file.path("outputs/mem_scores_selected.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

africa  <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(continent = "Africa", returnclass = "sf") |> sf::st_union()
mask_fp <- ("data/processed/sampled_mask_sf.rds")
sampled <- if (file.exists(mask_fp)) readRDS(mask_fp) else NULL
TXT   <- 23    # axis text and legend text (pt)
TITLE <- 22    # panel title
th <- theme_classic(base_size = TXT) +            # classic = no grid
  theme(panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black", size = TXT),
        axis.line        = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black"),
        plot.title       = element_text(colour = "black", size = TITLE, face = "bold"),
        legend.title     = element_text(colour = "black", size = TXT + 2),
        legend.text      = element_text(colour = "black", size = TXT),
        legend.key.size  = unit(0.9, "cm"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

make_map <- function(m) {
  d <- data.frame(lon = sites$site_lon, lat = sites$site_lat, score = sites[[m]])
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = africa, fill = "#E3E3E3", colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2)
  if (!is.null(sampled))
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = sampled, fill = "#F7F7F7", colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25)
  p +
    geom_point(data = d, aes(lon, lat, size = abs(score), fill = score > 0),
               shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "#2166AC"),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "positive", `FALSE` = "negative"), name = "Sign",
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 9), name = paste0("|", m, " score|")) +
    coord_sf(xlim = range(d$lon) + c(-3, 3), ylim = range(d$lat) + c(-3, 3), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = m, x = NULL, y = NULL) + th
}

for (m in sel) {
  out <- file.path("outputs/figures", paste0("FigS_", m, ".png"))
  ggsave(out, make_map(m), width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
  message("Saved ", out)
}
```

#Indicator value(IndVal)

```{r}
multi <- res$indval
host  <- as.character(comm_obj$host)

#Indicator table
sign_tab <- multi$sign; A_tab <- multi$A; B_tab <- multi$B
host_groups <- colnames(sign_tab)[grepl("^s\\.", colnames(sign_tab))]
grp_label <- apply(sign_tab[, host_groups, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r)
  paste(gsub("^s\\.", "", host_groups[which(r == 1)]), collapse = "+"))
get_AB <- function(tab, idx, grp) {
  cols <- intersect(strsplit(grp, "\\+")[[1]], colnames(tab))
  if (!length(cols)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(as.numeric(tab[idx, cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
}
supp <- data.frame(Lineage = rownames(sign_tab), Host_group = grp_label,
                   stat = round(sign_tab$stat, 3), p_value = round(sign_tab$p.value, 3))
supp$A <- round(vapply(seq_len(nrow(supp)), function(i) get_AB(A_tab, i, supp$Host_group[i]), 0), 3)
supp$B <- round(vapply(seq_len(nrow(supp)), function(i) get_AB(B_tab, i, supp$Host_group[i]), 0), 3)
supp$Signif <- cut(supp$p_value, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
supp <- supp[order(-supp$stat), c("Lineage", "Host_group", "A", "B", "stat", "p_value", "Signif")]
write.csv(supp, file.path("outputs/tables/indicator_analysis.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(supp, row.names = FALSE)

#Heatmap: % of each host's sites where the cluster occurs
assoc <- sapply(sort(unique(host)), function(h) colMeans(comm[host == h, , drop = FALSE])) * 100
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  indval_wide,
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = dist(indval_for_clustering),
  clustering_distance_cols = dist(t(indval_for_clustering)),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90","#FDCC8A","#FC8D59","#E34A33","#B30000"))(100),
  breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101),
  border_color = "white",          # was grey — this is the main visible mismatch
  na_col = "grey90",
  display_numbers = FALSE,
  legend_breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
  legend_labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%"),
  fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 13,
  angle_col = 0,
  fontsize = 11,
  filename = "outputs/figures/heatmap_indval.png",
  width = 9, height = 7
)
```

#Network specialization (H2')

```{r}
#Build host × lineage interaction matrix
web <- metadata |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Plant_host), !is.na(Groups)) |>
  dplyr::count(Plant_host, Groups) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=Groups,
    values_from=n, values_fill=0) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Plant_host") |>
  as.matrix()

#H2' network specialization
cat("\n=== H2' network specialization ===\n")
h2 <- bipartite::H2fun(web, H2_integer=TRUE)
print(h2)
cat("\nH2' =", round(h2["H2"],3),"\n")
cat("(0 = no specialization, 1 = perfect",
    "specialization)\n")

#Significance vs null model (Patefield)
cat("\n=== Null model test (999 Patefield nulls) ===\n")
set.seed(SEED_COMM)
nulls <- bipartite::nullmodel(web,
  N=999, method="r2dtable")
h2_null <- sapply(nulls, function(x)
  bipartite::H2fun(x, H2_integer=TRUE)["H2"])
h2_obs <- h2["H2"]
p_val <- (sum(h2_null >= h2_obs)+1)/(length(h2_null)+1)
cat("Observed H2':", round(h2_obs,3),"\n")
cat("Null mean H2':", round(mean(h2_null),3),
    " SD:", round(sd(h2_null),3),"\n")
cat("p-value:", round(p_val,4),"\n")
cat("z-score:",
    round((h2_obs-mean(h2_null))/sd(h2_null),2),"\n")

# Species-level specialization (d')
cat("\n=== Species-level d' (per lineage) ===\n")
sl <- bipartite::specieslevel(web,
  index="d", level="higher")
sl_df <- data.frame(
  Lineage=rownames(sl),
  d_prime=round(sl$d,3)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(d_prime))
print(sl_df, row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n(d': 0 = generalist, 1 = specialist)\n")

cat("\n=== Species-level d' (per host) ===\n")
sl_h <- bipartite::specieslevel(web,
  index="d", level="lower")
sl_h_df <- data.frame(
  Host=rownames(sl_h),
  d_prime=round(sl_h$d,3)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(d_prime))
print(sl_h_df, row.names=FALSE)

saveRDS(list(web=web, H2=h2, p=p_val, d_lineage=sl_df, d_host=sl_h_df), "outputs/network_specialization.rds")
write.csv(sl_df, "outputs/tables/d_prime_lineage.csv", row.names=FALSE)

#-----------------Plot------------------------------------
ns <- readRDS("outputs/network_specialization.rds")
web <- ns$web

host_names <- c(Ar_hy="Ar_hy", Gl_ma="Gl_ma",
  Ph_vu="Ph_vu", Vi_un="Vi_un")
rownames(web) <- host_names[rownames(web)]
colnames(web) <- gsub("_"," ", colnames(web))

group_cols <- c(
  "B. elkanii cluster"="#E76F51",
  "B. japonicum cluster"="#F4A261",
  "Bradyrhizobium cluster"="#E9C46A",
  "Bradyrhizobium novel"="#8B0000",
  "M. tropici cluster"="#90E0EF",
  "R. leguminosarum cluster"="#2A9D8F",
  "R. phaseoli cluster"="#264653",
  "R. radiobacter cluster"="#48CAE4",
  "Rhizobium cluster"="#888888",
  "Martinezella cluster"="#ADE8F4",
  "Rhizobium novel"="#1B1BB3")
col_vec <- group_cols[colnames(web)]
col_vec[is.na(col_vec)] <- "grey70"

h2_val <- round(ns$H2["H2"], 3)
p_val  <- ns$p

png("outputs/figures/Fig_network_H2.png",
    width=12, height=7.5, units="in", res=320)
bipartite::plotweb(
  web,
  main = paste0(
    "Rhizobia\u2013legume interaction network  (H2' = ",
    h2_val, ", p = ", format.pval(p_val, digits=3), ")"),
  srt = 90,
  text_size = 0.85,
  higher_color = col_vec,
  higher_border = "same",      
  higher_italic = TRUE,
  lower_color = "#4A7C59",
  lower_border = "same",
  link_color = "grey55",
  link_border = "same",
  link_alpha = 0.45,
  curved_links = TRUE,
  mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1)
)
```
